experiences.companyName: SportMeNow (Product of SixPack Apps Pte Ltd)
experiences.description:
Co Founder of SportMeNow – a unique platform disrupting the Singaporean Bar and Pub industry. SportMeNow is a simple and fun application that connects sports fans with the bars/pubs across Singapore by displaying which bars/pubs are televising which particular sport matches. SportMeNow is available via Website, iOS and Android. 

Partnered with popular Singapore Bars such as: Beer Market, Molly Malone's, BQ Bar, Mulligans, HopDog, Mogambo Bar, The Bank Bar, Oleary's Flyer, Oleary's Changi, 6 Prawns & a Beer, The Mad Men Bar, The Merry Men Bar, Prince of Wales, Muddy Murphys, Penny Black Bar, London Bar, Ice Cold Beer and Pint & Curries
